hooks.text: A star 12 miles wide physically warped Earth's atmosphere.
A 12-mile-wide dead star outshone 150,000 years of sunlight.
A tenth of a second outshone 150,000 years of sunlight.

title: The Dead Star That Warped Earth
description: In 2004, a massive starquake on a magnetar 50,000 light-years away released enough energy to physically expand Earth's upper atmosphere.

beats.text: A star 12 miles wide physically warped Earth's atmosphere.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of magnetar SGR 1806-20 with magnetic field lines, NASA, 2004
queries: Magnetar magnetic field lines artist impression

beats.text: The magnetar SGR 1806-20 is a dead star with a magnetic field of 1,000 trillion gauss.
beats.visual: Illustration of the intense magnetic fields of a magnetar, NASA, 2004
queries: Magnetar magnetic field artist concept NASA

beats.text: On December 27, 2004, on the opposite side of the Milky Way, magnetic stress fractured its ultradense core in a massive starquake.
beats.visual: Diagram of the cracked crust and magnetic reconnection of a magnetar, NASA, 2005
queries: Neutron star crust cross section diagram

beats.text: In a tenth of a second, the rupture released more energy than the Sun does in 150,000 years.
beats.visual: Artist impression of a gamma-ray burst from a magnetar rupture, NASA, 2004
queries: Gamma ray burst blast wave artist concept NASA

beats.text: Traveling 50,000 light-years, the burst momentarily matched the full Moon's brightness in gamma rays.
beats.visual: Full Moon photographed in visible light showing lunar terrain, NASA, 2010
queries: Milky Way galaxy map spiral arms

beats.text: That wave struck our ionosphere, ionizing gas and forcing the upper atmosphere to expand.
beats.visual: Earth atmospheric layers showing the ionosphere structure, NASA, 2004
queries: Earth upper atmosphere ionosphere structure diagram

beats.text: If this erupted within ten light-years, it would have caused mass extinction.
beats.visual: Artist concept of Earth's atmosphere stripped by intense cosmic radiation, NASA, 2008
queries: Atmosphere stripping cosmic radiation artist concept NASA

beats.text: Even from across the galaxy, this tiny starquake still physically warped the world above us.
beats.visual: Diagram of Earth's ionosphere expanding under gamma-ray bombardment, NASA, 2004
queries: Earth night side from orbit NASA
